#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Two-bar grouped bar chart with error bars (PDC vs HDF5 bandwidth).
Reads from data1.csv, outputs dlio.pdf.
"""

import os
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from google.colab import drive
drive.mount('/content/drive')

# ── File paths ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_file   = "/content/drive/MyDrive/data-flyway-eval-plots/data/dlio/data1.csv"
output_file = "/content/drive/MyDrive/data-flyway-eval-plots/exps/dlio.pdf"

# ── Read CSV ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df = pd.read_csv(data_file)

node_counts = df["node_count"].tolist()
pdc_avg  = df["pdc_avg"].values
pdc_std  = df["pdc_std"].values
hdf5_avg = df["hdf5_avg"].values
hdf5_std = df["hdf5_std"].values

n = len(node_counts)
x = np.arange(1, n + 1)

# ── Layout constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BAR_WIDTH  = 0.35
HDF5_SHIFT = -0.175
PDC_SHIFT  = +0.175

# ── Colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
COLOR_PDC  = "#5C9BD6"
COLOR_HDF5 = "#EF5350"
COLOR_PCT  = "#2ca02c"

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 10))

pdc_gb  = pdc_avg  / 1000
pdc_e   = pdc_std  / 1000
hdf5_gb = hdf5_avg / 1000
hdf5_e  = hdf5_std / 1000

# ── Bars ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.bar(x + HDF5_SHIFT, hdf5_gb, BAR_WIDTH,
       color=COLOR_HDF5, edgecolor=COLOR_HDF5, linewidth=0.5,
       label="HDF5", zorder=3)
ax.bar(x + PDC_SHIFT, pdc_gb, BAR_WIDTH,
       color=COLOR_PDC, edgecolor=COLOR_PDC, linewidth=0.5,
       label="PDC", zorder=3)
ax.bar(x + HDF5_SHIFT, hdf5_gb, BAR_WIDTH,
       color='none', edgecolor='black', linewidth=2.0, zorder=4)
ax.bar(x + PDC_SHIFT, pdc_gb, BAR_WIDTH,
       color='none', edgecolor='black', linewidth=2.0, zorder=4)

# ── Error bars ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.errorbar(x + HDF5_SHIFT, hdf5_gb, yerr=hdf5_e,
            fmt="none", ecolor="black", elinewidth=2, capsize=0, zorder=5)
ax.errorbar(x + PDC_SHIFT, pdc_gb, yerr=pdc_e,
            fmt="none", ecolor="black", elinewidth=2, capsize=0, zorder=5)

# ── Percentage-lift labels (above top of error bar) ───────────────────────────
LABEL_PAD = 0.005  # small fixed gap above the error bar tip in GB/s
for i in range(n):
    pct     = (pdc_avg[i] - hdf5_avg[i]) / hdf5_avg[i] * 100
    label_y = pdc_gb[i] + pdc_e[i] + LABEL_PAD
    ax.text(x[i] + PDC_SHIFT, label_y, f"+{pct:.0f}\%",
            ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=22, color=COLOR_PCT,
            zorder=6)

# ── Axes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xlabel("Number of GPU Processes", fontsize=28)
ax.set_ylabel("GB/sec", fontsize=28)
ax.set_xlim(0.3, n + 0.7)
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(nc) for nc in node_counts], fontsize=24)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=24)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", which="minor", left=False)
ax.grid(axis="y", which="major", linewidth=1.5, color="black", alpha=0.25)
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.legend(loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.12),
          ncol=2, fontsize=22, frameon=True,
          edgecolor="#aaaaaa", columnspacing=1.0)

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_file), exist_ok=True)
plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(output_file, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
print(f"Saved {output_file}")
